text_block_list.text:
Before heading out to race in the Arima 
Kinen, Gold Ship found herself reflecting 
on today's race, drawing parallels to life 
itself.

Cross a huge mountain and head out into 
the vast ocean! Once Gold Ship sets sail, 
nobody can stop her. And that applies to 
races too.

A battle against rivals she has clashed 
with time and again. The final race of the 
Twinkle Series is about to begin at last—!
